about: Executed acts in the 7-day window that the G3 sequences do not reach, each decided by capsule-engine a710636c under asg/everyday/0.3.6 (engine-results.json) and held to it by go/guard/g3_engine_test.go. Every act is one of ../g3-executed-acts-vectors/templates with the named edits (build.py).

sequences.name: pay-escalate
sequences.why: a history act sealed with a decision other than accept is still an executed act: counted at its sealed spend

sequences.name: pay-no-decision
sequences.why: the same pay sealed with no disposition: counted at its sealed spend

sequences.name: pay-escalate-unreadable
sequences.why: a history act sealed escalate whose spend cannot be read leaves the window not evaluable

sequences.name: refund-out-spend
sequences.why: an fyi refund stating money out with a spend: a reversal that cites no charge, so it adds nothing (unlinked)

sequences.name: commit-cancel-class
sequences.why: an executed act classed booking.cancel with a spend adds nothing (unlinked)

sequences.name: unchecked-cancel-class
sequences.why: an act taken without a check, classed booking.cancel, adds nothing (unlinked)

sequences.name: commit-money-in
sequences.why: an executed act stating money in counts 0 whatever its spend

sequences.name: pay-accept-refund-class
sequences.why: an accepted act classed money.refund is the fold's reversal record, unlinked

sequences.name: per-action-over-unreadable
sequences.why: a per-action limit the action exceeds still fails beside an unreadable act; the evidence names window_unreadable_count

sequences.name: accepted-and-unreadable-same-action
sequences.why: an unreadable record of an act already accepted (the same action_id) is the same act: dropped, so it does not hold the window

sequences.name: two-fyi-same-action-different-spend
sequences.why: two records of one act: the older, which the engine writes first, is the one counted

sequences.name: unreadable-then-readable-same-action
sequences.why: the older record of the act cannot be read: it holds the window, and the later copy is dropped

sequences.name: same-action-across-window-edge
sequences.why: a copy outside the window still claims the act, so the copy inside it is dropped
